::: {.lead}
A comprehensive, open-access medical documentation of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis / Chronic Fatigue Syndrome — a severe, chronic, multi-system neuroimmune disease affecting an estimated 0.89--2.5% of the global population.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Medical Disclaimer
This documentation represents literature synthesis, **not clinical advice**. All treatment decisions must be made in consultation with qualified healthcare providers.
:::

---

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-12}

## The Paper

A structured reference work spanning five parts, with an epistemic classification system (achievements, hypotheses, speculations, predictions, warnings, recommendations). Available as a navigable website and [downloadable PDF](loth2026-mecfs.pdf).

- **[Part I — Clinical Presentation:](part1-clinical/ch01-introduction/01-introduction-to-me-cfs.html)** — Core and additional symptoms, diagnostic criteria, disease course
- **[Part II — Pathophysiology:](part2-pathophysiology/ch07-energy-metabolism/01-energy-metabolism-and-mitochondrial-function.html)** — Energy metabolism, immune dysfunction, neurological, endocrine, cardiovascular, gut-microbiome, integrative models
- **[Part III — Treatment:](part3-treatment/ch21-mechanism-treatment-map/01-mechanism-treatment-map.html)** — Symptom management, medications, supplements, lifestyle interventions, emerging therapies
- **[Part IV — Research Evidence:](part4-research/ch34-research-methods/01-me-cfs-specific-research-methods.html)** — Biomarker research, clinical trials, mechanistic studies, epidemiology, controversies
- **[Part V — Quantitative Modeling:](part5-modeling/ch48-modeling-foundations/01-foundations-of-me-cfs-modeling.html)** — Mathematical models of disease dynamics using ordinary differential equations
